findings.title: Critical Security Headers Missing
findings.description: Header score 0/100 — multiple critical headers absent.

findings.title: Clickjacking Vulnerability
findings.description: Page can be embedded in an iframe — clickjacking possible.
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

findings.title: No security.txt / Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
findings.description: No security.txt file found. Researchers have no official contact for vulnerability reports.
findings.remediation: Create /.well-known/security.txt per RFC 9116 with Contact: and Policy: fields.
